name: verify
description: Verify gate for the main loop and every subagent: no success claim without a real check. Optional live runner of only the tests related to each edit (opt-in: it runs the project's own test scripts).

liveTests.title: Run related tests after each edit
liveTests.description: Runs the project's own test command in the background, with no permission prompt, after Claude edits code inside the session's folder. Only turn on for projects you trust.
